item.title: Seino Holdings works with rivals for better, cleaner transportation
item.description: In Japan’s logistics industry, companies have maintained independent delivery networks, with trucks from multiple companies operating in the same areas. In addition, due to smaller shipments and underused return trips, the “loading efficiency” of freight vehicles has remained at around 40% of what they could carry for the past 15 years or so. This is not only inefficient, but also hinders efforts to reduce carbon dioxide emissions in the industry.
